content: Mathlib contains the result that on a uniform compact Hausdorff space, the uniform structures consists of the neighborhoods of the diagonal docs#compactSpace_uniformity but it doesn't seem to contain the other part of the classical result, namely that on a compact Hausdorff space, neighborhoods of the diagonal constitute a uniformity. Does it?
